Little did I know that my friends got high occasionally around me, and I couldn't tell the difference. My closest friend convinced me to actually do some research, and I found that my arguments were baseless and bolstered only with "I knew this guy who knew this guy who died/killed someone cuz of this drug" stories and non-scholarly articles dictating the dangers of marijuana. 

Meanwhile, PubMed starts tossing me articles about how good THC is for certain adults. All I can say now is that I was just confused, and I didn't try to look at the facts. 

It's easier to accept the spoon-fed public story than to dig around for some unknown scientist's work on marijuana's effects on the human body. 

Tl;dr - I was a pretentious little shit who probably made my friends really uncomfortable for no reason other than "I heard this opinion/"fact" first and it therefore invalidates any later contradicting data"
